items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: How long did you play with David Solero? ... I was playing right home.

ctx.x: Have you ever used a capo on your guitar? You know what I mean? Yeah, I know. You know what I mean? You know what I mean? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
How long did you play with David Solero?
Oh I didn't know. Goodbye. When he left, after he left town then, after he left Moulady, I was playing right home.
